image_description: Two large blue plastic industrial drums (55-gallon style) repurposed as rain barrels, sitting on a wooden pallet outdoors. The left barrel has a green hose connected to a spigot near the bottom and various white labels/stickers on its side. The right barrel is similar, with a hose connection visible. A chain-link fence and vegetation are in the background.
